verdict: Leads down this week; Google spend confirmed wasted, action underway.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 133 leads at an average cost of $19.24 per lead — all of them coming from Meta, which carried the full load. Google Ads consumed $1,144.71 of your budget over the same period and produced zero conversions; this is a confirmed performance failure, not a tracking issue, and that spend is being reallocated. On Meta, leads fell 41.3% week-over-week while daily spend held steady near $90, meaning your cost per lead is rising — new ad creative is being introduced this week to reverse that trend. Looking ahead, new landing pages and a fresh creative batch are scheduled to go live by August 31, which should give Meta stronger material to work with heading into September.
